channel.title: Hack the Platform Blog
channel.description: Insights, tutorials, and stories about Microsoft Power Platform and beyond. Empower your business with Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Agents, and more.

item.title: Power Pages & SPA (Part 1): Deploying a Custom React SPA to Microsoft Power Pages
item.description: Learn how to build a Vite + React Single Page Application, deploy it to Power Pages using the official Power Platform CLI, and preserve your configuration safely.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Power Pages & SPA (Part 3): Fetching Dataverse Data Securely
item.description: In Part 3, we’ll connect our Power Pages + React SPA to Dataverse using the Web API. You’ll learn to enable API access, set permissions for authenticated users, and securely fetch data with CSRF token handling. We’ll also build a simple UI to display Accounts, validating our authentication setup from Part 2.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Power Pages & SPA (Part 4): Starting a Power Automate Flow from React SPA
item.description: Learn how to securely start a Power Automate flow from your React SPA in Power Pages, fetching Dataverse data without exposing tables or permissions.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Power Pages & SPA Part 5: Using Server Logic in React SPA
item.description: How to call Power Pages Server Logic from a React SPA using Microsoft Entra ID app credentials stored in Power Pages site settings and environment variables.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)
